record.paper_title: Three open problems and a conjecture
record.original_question: For an integer k ≥ 2, evaluate in closed form the multiple series T_k = Σ_{n_1,...,n_k ≥ 1} (-1)^{n_1+...+n_k} H_{n_1}H_{n_2}···H_{n_k}/(n_1 n_2 ··· n_k (n_1+n_2+...+n_k)), where H_m = Σ_{j=1}^m 1/j is the m-th harmonic number.

evidence.quote: 3.135. Let k 2 be an integer. Evaluate, in closed form, the multiple series Tk D X1 n1;···;nkD1 .1/n1Cn2C···Cnk Hn1Hn2 · · · Hnk /(n1n2 · · · nk.n1 C n2 C · · · C nk/).
We give only a partial result to this problem which we record in the next theorem.

Remark 1.3. It is worth mentioning that the problem cannot be solved in the sense that in general, alternating sums appear which are (conjecturally) not expressible as polynomials in ζ(s), ln 2 and Li_s(1/2).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a positive integer m, let H_m = 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + ... + 1/m denote the m-th harmonic number. For an integer k ≥ 2, evaluate in closed form the k-fold series
   T_k = Σ_{n_1=1}^∞ Σ_{n_2=1}^∞ ··· Σ_{n_k=1}^∞ (-1)^{n_1+n_2+...+n_k} · (H_{n_1} H_{n_2} ··· H_{n_k}) / (n_1 n_2 ··· n_k (n_1 + n_2 + ··· + n_k)),
expressing the value, if possible, in terms of standard constants such as values of the Riemann zeta function ζ(s), ln 2, and polylogarithm values Li_s(1/2). In particular, determine whether such a closed form exists for every k ≥ 2.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem with only a partial result known; for general k the alternating sums that arise are conjecturally not expressible as polynomials in ζ(s), ln 2, and Li_s(1/2), so the closed-form evaluation in this restricted form is not expected. No general closed-form solution has been located in the literature.
